pages.text: If you hold $(1)$(k:sneak)$() while chopping a tree, you'll break all of the logs at once! This takes a little longer than chopping the logs individually and costs just as much durability, but it's still great for harvesting large trees.$(br2)It works on Nether trees, too, although in that case, you'd want to bring a hoe to clear out the wart blocks.

Certain axes and logs have special effects or drops. In these cases, felling the entire tree at once will act as though your currently-held axe has manually broken each log, so there's no need to worry about wasting resources.
